LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Research_Integration_Helm.des: A unified kwazaari alloy helm that consolidates the quantum rebreather and forge calibration optics into a single system. Its integrated circuitry alternates between filtration monitoring for hazardous synthesis work and thermal gradient tracking for forge alignment — switching seamlessly as the task demands.

LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Convergence_Gauntlets.label: kwazaari convergence gauntlets
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Convergence_Gauntlets.descrip: Structured gauntlets with a layered guidance system built from kwazaari alloy. The inner haptic mesh assists with neutronium substrate handling during synthesis, while the reinforced outer shell keeps hand position locked during bionic implant installation. The quality of the craft determines how precisely the two systems work in tandem.
